verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a first-party help article titled "Searching your mail", so mail search is a documented product capability. A community user also describes building a filter that showed all mail delivered to one address within a date window, a hands-on hint of address and date filtering. The pack contains only the article title, with no content on operators, ranking, speed or full-history coverage. Missing for 10: documented search operators/syntax, ranked or relevance-sorted results, evidence of search speed, confirmation of coverage across full mail history, independent hands-on corroboration of search precision.

support.subject: As a power-user, search is fast and precise — operators, filters, and ranked results across my full mail history

citations.quote: set up a filter on Fastmail showing all mail delivered to the old @gmail.com address in the last two weeks
